name: doyel-labs-site
description: doyel-labs.com — the company site for Doyel Labs LLC (Casper, Wyoming). Websites and custom software, built by a person you can call.

scripts.build: next build && node --import tsx scripts/package-admin.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/csp-hashes.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/generate-public-paths.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p functions/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p workers/location-retention/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run check && wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=website --branch=master
